boundary_refinements.bukhari:2437.2:hi: The finite encounter and respondent uncertainty are displayed as distinct ordered, qualified components within one family; the absent I/he links remain unspecified.
boundary_refinements.bukhari:2437.2:ur: The added encounter and actual material doubt are separately attributed to the source unspecified voices, with the route/pointer retained in context.

bukhari:2390.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Abu Hurayrah report transmitted by Abu Salamah includes the demanding creditor, contemplated punishment, Prophet instruction to let the right-holder speak, purchase of an older camel and praise of good repayment. Retain the parenthetic loan relation because it defines the camel used as the comparison object. No separate commentary follows in this field; unnamed creditor remains unnamed.
bukhari:2390.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Abu Hurayrah report includes the creditor demand, companion reaction, Prophet restraint and replacement-camel repayment instruction. Retain the parenthetic prior-loan relation as actual comparison-object scope. The final parenthetic assertion that the hadith matches the chapter is compiler apparatus and remains context, with no report content added.

bukhari:2394.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Jabir reports the mosque visit, two-rakah command and repayment with extra. Misar explicitly says he thinks the time of duha was mentioned; preserve that named material temporal uncertainty as a distinct transmitter-attributed component in the same report family, not Prophet speech. Provisionally retain the parenthetic visit-at-that-time clause as its actual temporal domain so the uncertainty is attached to arrival rather than silently reassigned to the later prayer or repayment. Resume Jabir event after this qualification.
bukhari:2394.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Jabir own visit, Prophet two-rakah instruction and debt repayment are finite. Misar named uncertain recollection of the duha time remains separately attributed within the same family. Provisionally retain the parenthetic arrival-at-that-time clause as source-supplied temporal scope of the named uncertainty. No confident prayer-time identity or missing actor is supplied.

bukhari:2395.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field, including the chain as printed. Jabir reports his father death at Uhud, pressing creditors, their refusal to accept garden dates in full settlement, Prophet next-morning visit and blessing prayer, then Jabir payment and remaining dates. The father-name parenthesis is an appended identity gloss and remains context. No repair is made to the supplied Kab ibn Malik route or any printed speaker wording.
bukhari:2395.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Preserve Jabir father debt and Uhud death setting, creditor refusal, withheld garden produce, promised next-morning visit, blessing prayer and actual payment with dates left over. The parenthetic father-name identification remains context; the actual father relationship and complete narrative remain. The source chain is not corrected or expanded.

bukhari:2401.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Abu Hurayrah reports the unnamed man harsh debt demand, companions contemplated chastisement and Prophet instruction to leave him because a right-holder can speak this way. Preserve the actual short report and its unspecified debtor-demand wording without adding the camel repayment from other IDs. No separate explanation or incomplete pointer occurs.
bukhari:2401.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. The unnamed man demand, companions reaction and Prophet own restraint statement form a finite report through Abu Hurayrah. Keep the supplied qard wording and actual right-holder scope; do not insert the related camel episode or identify the man.

bukhari:2405.hi: Read this complete1867-character Hindi field. Jabir supplies two actual episodes: father Abdullah death, creditors refusal and miraculous date payment; then a campaign camel sale, reserved ride to Medina, marriage and family-care explanation, maternal-uncle response, payment, returned camel and campaign share. Retain both my-father parentheses as relationship scope, including inside the later independently bounded marriage explanation. Retain the other-occasion parenthesis because it separates the episode timing. Use two source report families in this one provider occurrence; no invented sisters or altered soft-date variety.
bukhari:2405.ur: Read the complete1766-character Urdu field. Jabir father-debt and date-distribution event is distinct from the later campaign/camel-sale/marriage narrative. Retain the explicit my-father relations and other-occasion temporal qualifier. The sale leaves the ride to Medina reserved, and the later record gives price, camel return and the ordinary campaign share; none of these is collapsed or omitted. Preserve every supplied variety name and anonymous participant.

bukhari:2406.hi: Separately read this complete1867-character Hindi source occurrence, despite wording matching2405. Both Jabir episodes are actually supplied: father-debt/date payment and later campaign camel sale with family/marriage explanation and returned camel. Keep its own ID and two source report families, meaningful father-relation and other-occasion parentheses, reserved ride and all final payments. No cross-ID deduplication or inferred omitted actor.
bukhari:2406.ur: Separately read this complete1766-character Urdu occurrence. Its literal date-payment story and later camel-sale/marriage event both remain, with two distinct source report families. Keep both first-person father relations, temporal transition, purpose of caring for younger girls, reserved ride, uncle reproach and final price/camel/share. The match with2405 does not replace this actual own-field reading or collapse the provider ID.

bukhari:2407.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. The source expressly names Umar after Abdullah ibn Dinar; do not silently replace him with Ibn Umar from a familiar parallel. The unnamed buyer complaint, Prophet no-deception formula and later repeated use of that formula are actual finite content. Whole own wording is eligible with attribution as printed, no expansion of buyer identity.
bukhari:2407.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Preserve the explicit Umar source attribution, the man complaint of deception, the Prophet instruction and subsequent practice. No external narrator-name correction is made; no compiler tail is supplied. The complete own field contains the actual report.

bukhari:2413.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Anas reports the assault, questioned injured girl, affirmative head gesture, suspect confession and ensuing command/outcome. Retain the still-alive parenthesis as actual temporal condition enabling her response, and the yes parenthesis as actual affirmative content of the gesture. Neither is a removable word definition. Preserve this as a historical attributed report without adding present instructions, unnamed persons or evidentiary conclusions.
bukhari:2413.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. The girl remaining life and affirmative head gesture are material event facts, so both parentheses remain within Anas report. The question, name cue, apprehension, confession and source-stated command/outcome remain exact. No extra legal or modern identity claim is introduced.

bukhari:2415.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Jabir reports the unnamed man freeing his only property, the Prophet return of the slave to him and the named Naim ibn Nahham purchase. Retain the lack-of-other-property limitation and all supplied actions. No absent testamentary or posthumous condition is imported from a parallel account.
bukhari:2415.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. The unnamed owner freeing a slave, having no other property, Prophet return and Naim ibn Nahham purchase form the supplied finite report. Preserve the printed name and no-other-property condition. Do not add a familiar omitted condition or alter the transaction.

bukhari:2418.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Kab reports his mosque debt demand from Ibn Abi Hadrad, both raised voices, Prophet hearing from home, opening the curtain, call and response, the explicit half-debt gesture, Kab actual remission and the direction to the debtor to pay. Preserve both actual speakers and the half amount. All supplied text is finite report content, with no source apparatus to remove.
bukhari:2418.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Keep the named creditor/debtor, mosque and home locations, raised voices, curtain, Kab reply, half-debt gesture, remission and Prophet payment instruction in order. This is a coherent historical dialogue; the half quantity is not replaced by a generic reduction. No extra commentary follows.

bukhari:2423.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Abu Hurayrah reports the mounted expedition to Najd, capture of the named Banu Hanifa man and his tying to a mosque pillar. This is actual finite abbreviated event content, not a bare pointer. Preserve the supplied Thumama name spelling and do not fill later conversion/release events from a familiar longer account.
bukhari:2423.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. The source supplies the Najd dispatch, named Thumama ibn Athal capture and mosque-pillar restraint. These finite acts are eligible on their own under Abu Hurayrah attribution. No unprinted continuation, motive or modern group conclusion is added.

bukhari:2425.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Khabbab reports his work and debt exchange with As ibn Wail, the latter demand to reject Muhammad, Khabbab refusal, their resurrection/wealth exchange and revelation. Preserve the actual verse transliteration and complete Hindi translation inside parentheses. The inserted kafir label and repeated second-life parenthesis are identity/temporal explanations, provisionally context; the surrounding source already states death and renewed life. The final end-of-verse pointer remains context and is not completed.
bukhari:2425.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Keep Khabbab debt dialogue, As ibn Wail actual conditional refusal and claimed future wealth, Khabbab sworn refusal and subsequent supplied Quran wording plus Urdu translation. The kafir parenthetical appraisal and repeated second-life gloss remain context because the actual clauses already specify resurrection. Keep the Prophet honorific and actual verse, and exclude only the final continuation pointer without filling an omitted ending.

bukhari:2427.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Zayd ibn Khalid reports the Bedouin questions about found property, sheep and a lost camel, with actual Prophet replies. Retain the parenthetic return-the-property imperative: it supplies the consequence of identifying the signs. Provisionally retain the owner parenthesis as the brother recipient ownership scope, which is more specific than an arbitrary brother. The with-which-it-will-walk parenthesis explains the hoof function and is provisionally context; the actual self-directed reaching water and eating leaves remain. Keep the year, signs, sheep alternatives, changed face and all finite replies.
bukhari:2427.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. The own report supplies a year announcement, container/binding signs, return on correct identification, sheep alternatives and camel self-sufficiency. Retain the parenthetic return command and provisionally the brother-as-owner recipient scope. The hoof-function relative explanation remains context, while the actual water and leaf actions remain selected. No lost-owner identity or omitted continuation is filled.

bukhari:2431.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Anas reports the Prophet seeing a date on the road and the conditional statement that he would have eaten it absent concern it was charity. Preserve the uncertainty and counterfactual scope; no assertion that the date actually was charity and no missing donation owner is added. Whole field is finite report content.
bukhari:2431.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Preserve the road date, Prophet conditional willingness to eat and explicit charity concern. The uncertainty remains unresolved; there is no commentary or missing-body pointer requiring expansion.

bukhari:2437.2.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. The initial Salamah/Ubay route and above-hadith pointer do not themselves supply the preceding report body. A genuine added encounter is supplied: the quoted I later met someone in Mecca, and the quoted respondent cannot recall whether Kab said one or three years. Retain that finite later encounter and material first-person uncertainty as a qualified transmitted addition, not Prophetic speech. The I/he referents are not uniquely established by the damaged/abridged wording; do not insert Shuba, identify the respondent by a familiar parallel, or settle one versus three. The two alternatives and uncertainty remain exact.
bukhari:2437.2.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Separate the opening above-hadith route/pointer from the actual quoted later Mecca encounter and unresolved one-or-three-years recollection. Source prints Salamah, Ubay ibn Kab and later Kab, but the quoted I and respondent links are not unambiguously expanded. Preserve a bounded later transmitted encounter/uncertainty with those unknowns, not a new Prophetic command or an imported parent report.

bukhari:2439.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Abu Bakr reports the shepherd encounter, owner/name inquiry, milk availability, request to milk, cleaning the udder and hands, cooling milk, presentation and Prophet drinking until Abu Bakr was pleased. Both supplied chains remain literal; the second-chain label is transmission apparatus context. Retain the migration-to-Medina parenthesis as actual circumstance and timing of Abu Bakr search, not an added narrator identity. The owner remains unnamed despite Abu Bakr saying he recognized the reported name.
bukhari:2439.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Preserve Abu Bakr full shepherd/milk sequence, cleaning and water-cooling actions, Prophet drinking and the personal satisfied outcome. The two transmission routes do not create two separate reports; only their explicit second-chain label is apparatus. Keep the parenthetic migration-to-Medina setting because it supplies the circumstance of this action. No unseen owner name or route correction is inserted.

bukhari:2450.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field, including the supplied Roman transliteration and full Hindi Quran rendering. Aisha explains the wife feared estrangement and relinquishment of her right; this is her actual exegetical statement, not Prophet speech. The parenthetic Quran-verse header is a source label and remains context. The actual verse wording/translation and the statement of revelation concerning this situation remain. No canonical verse locator or omitted legal qualification is introduced.
bukhari:2450.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Preserve the exact Arabic verse excerpt, Urdu translation and Aisha own explanation of feared separation and the wife relinquishing her right. The introductory Quran-verse label is apparatus, whereas the actual Quran text and translation are substantive source quotation. No claim of separate Prophetic speech or modern ruling is added.

bukhari:2460.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Aisha reports Hind question about Abu Sufyan resources for her children and the Prophet customary-amount permission. Retain the parenthetical husband relationship as material participant/property scope; without it the printed permission could appear to concern an unrelated man money. Its third-person form remains visibly source-supplied narrative qualification, not repaired into Hind first-person wording. Preserve the named father and all source phrasing without external correction.
bukhari:2460.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Aisha relays Hind concern about Abu Sufyan stinginess and the request to feed her children, followed by the bounded customary-amount response. The explicit husband parenthesis limits the actor relationship and remains; its third-person wording is not converted into independently verified first-person speech. All source names and the custom limitation remain literal.

bukhari:2461.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Uqba ibn Amir conveys the collective question about being dispatched to various people, sometimes refused hospitality, and the Prophet conditional response. Retain the sometimes parenthesis because it limits the frequency of refusal and avoids making the complaint universal. Preserve the suitable-hosting condition and its stated alternative; no present-day instruction or unprinted exemption is added.
bukhari:2461.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Uqba report supplies dispatches, occasional non-hospitality, the request for guidance and Prophet conditional answer. The some-times qualifier remains essential frequency scope; both alternative outcomes remain exactly printed. There is no compiler appendix to register.

bukhari:2462.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Ibn Abbas transmits Umar own historical account of the Ansar gathering at Saqifa after Prophet death, Umar request to Abu Bakr and their arrival. The second-chain marker is transmission apparatus, while both chains stay literal and the finite Umar report remains a Companion testimony, not Prophet speech. Keep the source Saqifa/place description and do not supply subsequent speeches or succession events.
bukhari:2462.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Umar, through Ibn Abbas, supplies the post-death gathering, his request and their actual arrival at Banu Saida Saqifa. Preserve this finite historical excerpt and literal routes; only the second-chain label is apparatus. No unseen continuation or attribution to the deceased Prophet is added.

bukhari:2464.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Anas reports serving date wine at Abu Talha house, announcement of prohibition, Abu Talha direction, actual disposal, street flow, people concern about those killed after drinking and the ensuing supplied revelation/translation. Retain the parenthetic revelation timing as an actual finite event circumstance and hearing-this as the reaction trigger; neither is a mere verse locator. Preserve the actual Roman Quran transliteration and Hindi translation. The terminal end-of-verse pointer remains context with any isolated terminal quotation apparatus; no missing Quran text is filled.
bukhari:2464.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Preserve Anas own service and disposal account, the source-announced prohibition, Abu Talha response and unnamed people concern, followed by actual Arabic Quran excerpt and Urdu rendering. Retain the parenthetic revelation timing and immediate-hearing circumstance as narrative sequence, not canonical location labels. Only the final verse-continuation pointer is context, and the original quotation/punctuation defects are not repaired.

bukhari:2467.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Usama ibn Zayd reports the Prophet ascending a high Medina building and asking about the seen trials likened to rain upon homes. Retain the near-future parenthesis because it limits the temporal force; preserve its printed stray apostrophe without repair. This is a source-attributed reported saying, not an independently asserted prediction or present event claim.
bukhari:2467.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Usama report supplies the high Medina building, Prophet question and rain-like trials description. The near-future qualifier is material temporal scope and remains selected. No current-event identification or additional prediction is supplied.

ibnmajah:2376.hi: Read the complete own Hindi field. Numan ibn Bashir reports his father gift of a slave and the request to witness it, followed by the all-sons question, negative answer and return instruction. The gift-to-visit transition is damaged and leaves an orphan honorific fragment; preserve the exact supplied wording and visibly qualify the gap. The responding figure is denoted by repeated Prophetic honorifics within this Hindi field, but its missing introductory name is not inserted from Urdu. No missing beneficiary, actor or wording is supplied.
ibnmajah:2376.ur: Read the complete own Urdu field. Numan ibn Bashir reports his father gift, actual visit to the Prophet to witness it, the all-sons equality question, father negative reply and instruction to return it. Retain every actor, purpose and response as supplied. This field independently supplies the named Prophet visit that the Hindi transition omits; no cross-language reconstruction is performed.
